Sam: Hey team — I just got summoned for jury duty for next week (starts Sat morning). I need someone to take my Saturday 20:00–04:00 oncall slot. Can anyone swap? I'm available to cover Sun 22:00–02:00 in return.
Jordan: I can take the Saturday night slot but only until 02:00. Is partial coverage OK? :thinking:
Sam: That's great — partial is better than nothing. Rita, could you pick up 02:00–04:00 to close the gap? I'll ping a followup to confirm.
Rita: I can take 02:00–04:00. Need a quick handoff on the warm cache steps for the embeddings service since the weekend traffic might spike.
Sam: Hand-off notes:
- Prewarm embedding cache: run `scripts/prewarm_embeddings.sh --region us-west-2` ~30m before start.
- Watch model pool "dedicated-m3" for OOMs; if OOMs spike, fall back to `model-compact-v2` (see runbook).
- Metrics to glance: token throughput, queue length, host GPU mem usage dashboard -> /dashboards/oncall/embeddings
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-oncall
Jordan: Thanks — I'll run the prewarm at 19:00 PT and leave a comment in the shift log.
oncall-bot: Scheduled shift change: Jordan -> 2026-03-21 20:00–2026-03-22 02:00 (manual swap)
oncall-bot: Scheduled shift change: Rita -> 2026-03-22 02:00–2026-03-22 04:00 (manual swap)
Alex: Quick FYI — there's a low-risk deploy to the embeddings service Saturday 01:30; it's behind a canary. If you see increased error rates, rollback command is `deployctl rollback embeddings-service --to previous`.
Rita: Got it. I'll keep an eye on canary and the error budget alert (pager threshold set at 2.5% for 5m).
Sam: Thanks all. I'll DM the runbook snippets and the prewarm logs before I leave. Appreciate the trade :heart:
Jordan: No worries — good luck with jury duty.
Rita: Thanks, Sam. Keep us posted if anything changes.
